title: poikilospermum erectum
intro: Poikilospermum erectum, commonly known as the "Fijian fireplant", is a tropical plant species native to the Pacific Islands, particularly in Fiji. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, antiseptic properties, and the potential to reduce fever. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
